programme.desc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...

programme.title: Planet Weird 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.

programme.title: Planet Weird 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal 2 #3
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia 2 #4
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #4
programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal 2 #3
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal 2 #4
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

programme.title: In for the Kill [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: 致命奇襲 [英/普]
programme.desc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度、狡猾和敏捷?

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution 1 #6
programme.desc: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #6
programme.desc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.

programme.title: Animals at Play 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的動物大部分時間都在玩耍.從喜歡追逐的貓,到可以解決謎題的黑猩猩.新研究表明遊戲幾乎是動物學習的全部核心,它不僅是樂趣和遊戲.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #1
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #1
programme.desc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #2
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #3
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #3
programme.desc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #4
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #4
programme.desc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #5
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.

programme.title: Turtle Beach
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.

programme.title: Wild Latin America 1 #3
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

programme.title: Africas Hunters 1 #1
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution 1 #4
programme.desc: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #4
programme.desc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形.

programme.title: Planet Weird 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.

programme.title: Planet Weird 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal 2 #3
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

programme.desc: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #5
programme.desc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia 2 #4

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #4
programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal 2 #4
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

programme.title: In for the Kill [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: 致命奇襲 [英/普]
programme.desc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度、狡猾和敏捷?

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution 1 #6
programme.desc: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #6
programme.desc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.

programme.title: Animals at Play 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的動物大部分時間都在玩耍.從喜歡追逐的貓,到可以解決謎題的黑猩猩.新研究表明遊戲幾乎是動物學習的全部核心,它不僅是樂趣和遊戲.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #1
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #1
programme.desc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #2
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #3
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #3
programme.desc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #4
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #4
programme.desc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa 2 #5
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.

programme.title: Turtle Beach
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.

programme.title: Wild Latin America 1 #3
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.

programme.title: Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

programme.desc: 宋子豪(狄龍飾)與李馬克(Mark,周潤發飾)是國際偽鈔集團重要人物,彼此情如手足.子豪的弟弟宋子杰(張國榮飾)剛剛考入警察訓練學校,女友鍾柔(朱寶意飾)對他情深一片.一次,宋子豪帶手下譚成(李子雄飾)去台灣與當地黑幫作偽鈔交易,卻遭譚成出賣,子豪最後向台灣警方自首,入獄三年.Mark得悉子豪被捕,孤身一人赴台為子豪報仇,卻不幸中槍成了跛子,從此在幫會地位一落千丈.與此同時,台灣黑幫唯恐子豪...

programme.title: Unbeatable[Can/Man]
programme.desc: Ching Fai is a former boxing champion who has struggled since his glory days, having gone to prison over involvement with the Triads due to financial problems and now working as a taxi driver. When...

programme.title: 激戰[粵/普]
programme.desc: 香港過氣西洋拳王程輝年輕時為了錢而幫對手打假拳,跟他的師傅因此決裂,事情被查出後還因此入獄幾年.出獄後,拳壇沒落的他做起的士司機,如今淪落成身負二十幾萬賭債的落魄中年.他為了躲債而跑到澳門謀生,靠跟他關係不錯的師兄楊慶新找到健身中心的工作來賺錢還債.程輝入住一間由王明君和梁佩丹母女倆擁有的合租房,觀察到明君時常受精神病困擾.小丹講述她爸爸四年前棄家跑掉而讓家庭支離破碎,連她弟弟也不幸遇溺死亡...

programme.title: The Pye-Dog[Can/Man]
programme.desc: Wangs father, being the rising star in the triad, is back from overseas to expand his power in Hong Kong, with his other attempt - to get Wang back...

programme.title: 野良犬[粵/普]
programme.desc: 謊言的掩飾下,陳滿堆與倔強的宏建立起真摰的友誼,打開了Miss張一直封閉的心扉,一同走進了屬於他們三人的天空.但隨著宏的父親鈕喬澤出現,美麗的謊言被拆穿,殘酷的真相被揭開,一直不為人知的真實身份終於曝光.

programme.title: Ah Fai The Dumb[Can/Man]
programme.desc: A mentally handicapped teen lives in a slum. He has to fend for himself when his mother remarries and emigrates to another country. An accidental fall from his balcony gives him clairvoyant sense...

programme.title: 天才與白痴[粵/普]
programme.desc: 白痴仔心地善良,活得無憂無慮,但命運要他變成神童,名與利滾滾而來,金錢物慾的背後卻活得空虛.命運又再一次向他開玩笑,神童即將變回白痴,得與失只有他自己心知.

programme.title: My Will , I Will[Can/Man]
programme.desc: Butterfly Wong (Carol Cheng), a rich widow who returns to Hong Kong to find the right man to father her child. She hires lawyer Eric Lee (Bennett Pang) to help her find the right man and offers 2 m...

programme.title: 你情我願[粵/普]
programme.desc: 鄭裕玲飾演一名從美國返回香港的富孀,想尋找舊情人周潤發.但在此期間,她卻為了財產和繼承權的問題希望生一個兒子,並為此願出二百萬重酬,導至律師彭健新見財起心,向鄭展開追求.另一方面,開設私家偵探社的周正在調查彭與奸商曾江合謀騙取別人工廠的陰謀,乃說服鄭從中幫忙怖下陷阱將工廠騙回.導演陸劍明為這部浪漫愛情喜劇添加進偵探鬥智的元素,透過男女之間的你追我逐展現出一種難得的幽默趣味.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.desc: With the Top 5 within reach, the contestants receive heartfelt letters from home and must turn family memories into dishes worthy of Immunity. From Kerala feasts and childhood fishing trips to backyard barbecues and native Australian flavours, each cook draws on love, nostalgia and sacrifice. As time pressure mounts, technical risks and emotional stakes rise in a deeply personal battle for safety.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
programme.desc: 五強漸近，參賽者收到暖心家書，要把家庭回憶化為美食。從喀拉拉盛宴、童年釣魚，到後院燒烤和澳洲本土風味，各人把愛、懷念與家人的犧牲融入料理。時間有限，技術挑戰和情感壓力同時升溫，令比賽別具個人意義。

programme.title: Locals Welcome[Eng]
programme.desc: In this episode, Suresh revisits the Scarborough community that shaped him, discovering how immigration has transformed its culinary landscape. Through shawarma, Tamil appams, Hakka cuisine and a lively food crawl, he celebrates regional traditions, immigrant resilience and cultural connections. Ultimately, Scarborough emerges as a welcoming place where food preserves heritage.

programme.title: 地膽滋味遊[英]
programme.desc: 今集蘇雷什重臨影響他極深的斯卡堡社區，看看移民怎改變其飲食面貌。透過沙威瑪、泰米爾阿帕姆、客家菜和車尾派對，他表揚地方傳統、移民堅韌和文化連繫。斯卡堡是個保存食物傳統，建立友誼和歸屬感的好地方。

programme.desc: The episode explores the Maldives, through its breathtaking seascapes and exclusive luxury. At Soneva Jani, Sashi discovers lavish villas, exceptional hospitality and unforgettable culinary experiences, from Sri Lankan crab curry and indulgent desserts to innovative surprise menus and beachside barbecues. The journey celebrates Maldivian-inspired cuisine, fresh seafood and a distinctive approach to sustainable luxury.

programme.title: 食盡全世界[英]
programme.desc: 今集來到馬爾代夫的索尼娃賈尼島，薩希帶我們參觀奢華的度假村別墅、體驗好客之道和難忘的美食。從斯里蘭卡咖喱青蟹、誘人的甜品、讓人意外的菜單，到沙灘燒烤，一起欣賞馬爾代夫美食、鮮美的海鮮和可持續性的享受。

programme.title: Navigating the World[Eng]
programme.desc: The episode explores Oceania's northern region, beginning with Vanuatu's traditional customs and New Caledonia's Melanesian heritage. We journey through Norfolk Island and New Zealand's North Island, showcasing Maori culture, spectacular coastlines, marine wildlife, glowworm caves, ancient forests and extraordinary geothermal landscapes. We celebrate the region's natural wonders and cultural diversity.

programme.desc: 今集我們來到大洋洲北部，探索瓦努阿圖的傳統習俗和新喀里多尼亞的歷史遺產。我們穿越諾福克島和新西蘭北島，展示毛利文化、壯麗海岸線、海洋野生動物、螢火蟲洞穴和地熱地貌等等，表揚自然奇景和文化多樣性。

To alleviate the need for culling, translocation experts try to move them to new parks where there are no elephants.

programme.desc: 這部以二戰前夕為背景的武術冒險電影,講述了一名身手不凡的格鬥家受僱於中國情報部門,一路闖關殺上多層高樓,旨在奪回一份記錄著入侵計畫的頂級軍事機密文件.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth hed want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

programme.title: 第一滴血 2
programme.desc: 約翰·蘭博被政府從監獄釋放,執行一項絕密任務,前往他最不想回去的地方——越南叢林.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

programme.title: 移動世界
programme.desc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

programme.title: 黑塔
programme.desc: 決定宇宙存亡的終極對決爆發!最後的槍客羅蘭跨越異次元,誓死抵禦黑衣人的邪惡侵襲.一旦黑暗塔倒塌,全宇宙將徹底陷入萬劫不復的深淵!

programme.title: Across The Tracks
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers—a straight-A student and a former reform school youth—face intense athletic rivalry and emotional strain when they compete on the same high school track team.

programme.title: 熱血豪情
programme.desc: 一對疏遠的兄弟——一個是成績優異的高材生,另一個則是曾進過感化院的叛逆青年——在加入同一所高中的田徑隊後,不僅得在賽場上激烈競爭,更面臨著情感上的沉重考驗.

programme.title: White House Down
programme.desc: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

programme.title: 白宮末日
programme.desc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

programme.title: 黑色九月
programme.desc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: In Doomsday, a deadly virus resurfaces decades after quarantine. As chaos erupts, a team enters the walled-off zone to find a cure. Action-packed and gritty, its a battle for survival.

programme.title: 決戰末世代
programme.desc: 在《決戰末世代》中,一種致命病毒於隔離數十年後再度現身.混亂爆發之際,一支小隊進入被封鎖的禁區尋找解藥.動作凌厲、風格粗獷,這是一場為生存而戰的殊死任務.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

programme.title: 唐山大兄
programme.desc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
programme.desc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: 紙人回魂
programme.desc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.title: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
programme.desc: After a hybrid monster slaughters her family, Gabriella becomes a Blood Hunter bent on revenge. Caught in an explosion, she is wounded and rescued by hunters Max and Kali, then joins their group. When they learn hybrid demons are planning an attack, the hunters strike first, raiding their lair to prevent disaster, only to fall into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
programme.desc: 女戰士Gabriella的家人慘死於異種怪物之手,她矢志復仇,成為血獵手。一次爆炸中,她身受重傷,被Max與Kali所救,並加入他們的獵手聯盟。得知異種惡魔即將發動襲擊,眾人先發制人突襲巢穴,試圖阻止..

programme.title: Model Family #5
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: 模範家庭 #5
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: 錯愛迷蹤
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

programme.title: Sinister - Luk Krok
programme.desc: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

programme.title: 罪慾 - 碌葛
programme.desc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。

programme.title: Model Family #6
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #48 [粵]
programme.desc: 伯虎為替枝山頂罪心有決定，並叫沈周替他將三笑姻緣故事付印成書。石榴為令枝山重振雄風，求一嗔道長指點迷津。秋拒絕嫁德魯，並行火炭路以表決心。伯虎為貫徹花癡行為，竟輕薄娉婷，徵明見狀揭穿其詭計。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 豪與Cindy被送往醫院，豪重傷昏迷，Cindy出院後卻告失蹤。龍等發現Cindy嫌疑最大，為不讓Cindy逃回美國，特意發放豪垂危的消息令她折返。Cindy受警方包圍本欲自盡，但經新開解打消念頭。Cindy說出與三死者間的恩怨。豪傷癒後探望獄中的Cindy，更向他說出已原諒她及仍深愛她。瑩遇上舊同事，得悉Ada將結婚，她發現龍好像為此事感失落。瑩特意在龍面對表演魔術開解他，發現只是誤會一場。謙特意邂逅如時受襲，卻幸得她拯救。新調查探色情場所違規行為，竟發現玉擔任按摩女郎。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #14 [粵]
programme.desc: 新偕保探望玉，原來她丈夫家聰因股票失利，竟將玉財產騙走後人間蒸發，剩下一堆債務給她，玉只好帶兒子斌回港生活。如為了引出襲擊謙的犯人湯國強，喬裝成謙助理。保決定接玉與斌到其家居住，自己搬去租予新的單位與他同住，更高薪請玉到麵檔工作。強被捕，如調查後發現他因向亡妻求婚的許願樹將被發展商伐去，所以才對付代表律師的謙。如向謙求助欲保存樹，但卻被謙冷嘲熱諷。謙又突然探訪如說出已成功保存古樹，更要她請吃飯答謝。在與龍約會一個月的紀念日上，瑩終明白自己在龍心中其實毫不重要，因此哭著離去。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #9 [粵]
programme.desc: 同對蘭有意，五安排二人約會。揚闖監牢救叛黨東，未果，泰懷疑揚所為。同向閏詢問約會意見，閏自作多情。同代蘭做功課，閏代同送回學堂。閏扭傷，同背之回家。勇引揚出現，揚殺勇，明替揚隱瞞身分。五竟不其然想蘭。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #10 [粵]
programme.desc: 閏發現同心上人是蘭，不是味兒。蘭拒絕同，五覺虧於同。五迴避蘭，蘭痛哭，五終表白，同目睹心如刀割。同打五，五不欲為蘭失去兄弟。摩以為同正與蘭交往，警告同，同提醒五，二人和好。閏知同討厭鴉片煙，冒死戒掉。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #85 [粵]
programme.desc: 哲知自己冷落了母親，嵐稱約了別人去看戲，可是嵐所約的人竟是無恥的肥九，信與哲聯手威脅肥九與嵐斷絕關係。之後又讓他們發現有人送上花束，並留言約會嵐，二人又合力以一齣自導自演的好戲，來嚇走這名「追求者」。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #86 [粵]
programme.desc: 華質問哲是否正與瑤拍拖，哲連聲否認，原來這天正是華生日，可是獨哲一人於翌日補送禮物。華聽後大怒，眾人堅信華愛上哲。華慘受情傷向哲訴苦，但其他同事以為是「斷背好友」，哲無奈當眾公開戀情，此時華突然出現。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #87 [粵]
programme.desc: 舞會上明會邀請一名女同事成為他第一支舞的舞伴，眾人皆認為乃上位好機會。恆嚷著要教嵐跳舞，令山大急，恆直言難忘明教她跳舞與做人的一番話。恆為嵐送上舞鞋而遇上了明，最後明首名舞伴的就是恆這名「徒弟」。

programme.desc: 伯虎為替枝山頂罪心有決定，並叫沈周替他將三笑姻緣故事付印成書。石榴為令枝山重振雄風，求一嗔道長指點迷津。秋拒絕嫁德魯，並行火炭路以表決心。伯虎為貫徹花癡行為，竟輕薄娉婷，徵明見狀揭穿其詭計。

programme.desc: 華質問哲是否正與瑤拍拖，哲連聲否認，原來這天正是華生日，可是獨哲一人於翌日補送禮物。華聽後大怒，眾人堅信華愛上哲。華慘受情傷向哲訴苦，但其他同事以為是「斷背好友」，哲無奈當眾公開戀情，此時華突然出現。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #87 [粵]
programme.desc: 舞會上明會邀請一名女同事成為他第一支舞的舞伴，眾人皆認為乃上位好機會。恆嚷著要教嵐跳舞，令山大急，恆直言難忘明教她跳舞與做人的一番話。恆為嵐送上舞鞋而遇上了明，最後明首名舞伴的就是恆這名「徒弟」。

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #48 [粵]
programme.desc: 伯虎為替枝山頂罪心有決定，並叫沈周替他將三笑姻緣故事付印成書。石榴為令枝山重振雄風，求一嗔道長指點迷津。秋拒絕嫁德魯，並行火炭路以表決心。伯虎為貫徹花癡行為，竟輕薄娉婷，徵明見狀揭穿其詭計。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 豪與Cindy被送往醫院，豪重傷昏迷，Cindy出院後卻告失蹤。龍等發現Cindy嫌疑最大，為不讓Cindy逃回美國，特意發放豪垂危的消息令她折返。Cindy受警方包圍本欲自盡，但經新開解打消念頭。Cindy說出與三死者間的恩怨。豪傷癒後探望獄中的Cindy，更向他說出已原諒她及仍深愛她。瑩遇上舊同事，得悉Ada將結婚，她發現龍好像為此事感失落。瑩特意在龍面對表演魔術開解他，發現只是誤會一場。謙特意邂逅如時受襲，卻幸得她拯救。新調查探色情場所違規行為，竟發現玉擔任按摩女郎。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #14 [粵]
programme.desc: 新偕保探望玉，原來她丈夫家聰因股票失利，竟將玉財產騙走後人間蒸發，剩下一堆債務給她，玉只好帶兒子斌回港生活。如為了引出襲擊謙的犯人湯國強，喬裝成謙助理。保決定接玉與斌到其家居住，自己搬去租予新的單位與他同住，更高薪請玉到麵檔工作。強被捕，如調查後發現他因向亡妻求婚的許願樹將被發展商伐去，所以才對付代表律師的謙。如向謙求助欲保存樹，但卻被謙冷嘲熱諷。謙又突然探訪如說出已成功保存古樹，更要她請吃飯答謝。在與龍約會一個月的紀念日上，瑩終明白自己在龍心中其實毫不重要，因此哭著離去。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #9 [粵]
programme.desc: 同對蘭有意，五安排二人約會。揚闖監牢救叛黨東，未果，泰懷疑揚所為。同向閏詢問約會意見，閏自作多情。同代蘭做功課，閏代同送回學堂。閏扭傷，同背之回家。勇引揚出現，揚殺勇，明替揚隱瞞身分。五竟不其然想蘭。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #10 [粵]
programme.desc: 閏發現同心上人是蘭，不是味兒。蘭拒絕同，五覺虧於同。五迴避蘭，蘭痛哭，五終表白，同目睹心如刀割。同打五，五不欲為蘭失去兄弟。摩以為同正與蘭交往，警告同，同提醒五，二人和好。閏知同討厭鴉片煙，冒死戒掉。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #86 [粵]
programme.desc: 華質問哲是否正與瑤拍拖，哲連聲否認，原來這天正是華生日，可是獨哲一人於翌日補送禮物。華聽後大怒，眾人堅信華愛上哲。華慘受情傷向哲訴苦，但其他同事以為是「斷背好友」，哲無奈當眾公開戀情，此時華突然出現。

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #49 [粵]
programme.desc: 伯虎為證明自己是「花癡」而大肆招親，秋香看見伯虎招親，伯虎赫見秋香，秋香怒摑伯虎後離開，伯虎唱出三笑姻緣，秋香出現，皇上指枝山才是奸夫。石榴怒責枝山不負責任，就像與鳳姐一夕風流一事，猶如縮頭烏龜。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #15 [粵]
programme.desc: 玉將自己的薪酬告之同事甘蓮與來發，兩人發覺玉人工幾乎倍於自己，因此大表不滿。斌自從回港後便一改活躍的性格，令玉摸不著頭腦。在眾好友努力下，瑩與龍幾經波折，二人終於復合。斌在學校打傷同學，不但沒有反省更打罵保，最後竟離家出走。幸得新提點，玉成功尋回兒子。但面對如此壓力，玉崩潰哭倒梯間。新成功開解玉，卻觸動自己當年與妻子女兒分離之事。龍等人執行任務期間，姜發現謙與如並肩而行，不禁主動上前查間兩人關係，令如哭笑不得。目標人物現身，眾人欲逮捕他之際卻引起槍戰，新更中槍倒地。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #16 [粵]
programme.desc: 新受槍傷，雖被射中要害，但卻被胸袋所裝的舊打火機救了一命。為了圍捕危險悍匪喪虎，龍與如兩組人合作調查，更將犯人藏身之所鎖定在尖沙咀。新出院，有人送上一玩具娃娃，而他發覺此娃娃與當年他送給女兒的是一模一樣，因此疑懷女兒已返港。新腦海中亦突然出現異象，令他主動到尖沙咀搜尋女兒行蹤。龍與如假扮情侶接近調查對象，可惜如身分被識破反被脅持，事件最終演變成街頭駁火，令尖沙咀變成戰場。龍約瑩晚飯，原來龍特意請來眾同事，更當眾公開二人的情侶關係。新回家，發現貌似他女兒的人正和玉搭訕。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #11 [粵]
programme.desc: 閏為同戒煙。五、蘭被摩告發，泰禁蘭再返學堂。蘭以太后金牌逼泰成全，泰不理會。榮欠賭債被打，五等相救，同更借錢給榮。泰命明逐五出學堂，五闖泰府見蘭，明止。蘭偷走會五，二人決私奔。摩追至，五將摩打至重傷。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #12 [粵]
programme.desc: 五被收監，泰要處決五，蘭求摩醒來並答應下嫁，摩聞言甦醒。五得悉蘭要嫁摩，到王府找蘭卻被摩阻。蘭、五相遇，五冷言相對，蘭傷心。揚勸服怡給五開鏢局，並辭去武學堂教官協助五振作。五首次押鏢遇山賊，幸揚相救。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #88 [粵]
programme.desc: 眾人託清潔工阿嬋為他們購飯盒，但發現飯盒竟似度身訂製，眾人稱奇！不過眾人翻查資料，卻發現沒有這間茶餐廳。勇欲透過阿嬋找出那「不存在的茶餐廳」，卻因此發現阿嬋是利用公司的倉作廚房，包辦了區內的飯盒生意。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #89 [粵]
programme.desc: 昌發現哲拍拖沒有向恆公開二人的關係，勸哲坦白。恆的徒弟要為哲介紹女友，恆答應。恆無意中看到哲與瑤拍拖，明顯地反感，更要哲「相睇」，結果兩婆孫吵了起來。恆誤會哲離家出走，嵐略施小計使恆開始接受瑤。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #90 [粵]
programme.desc: 恆與山原想約嵐和哲行山，哲欲陪母親等送貨，恆感不是味兒。信指當年比堅更加早認識嵐，亦比堅對嵐更早產生愛意。而信更一直以筆名與嵐通信，而嵐則誤會寫信給她的人就是堅，更因巧合造就了嵐和堅的戀情。

programme.desc: 伯虎為證明自己是「花癡」而大肆招親，秋香看見伯虎招親，伯虎赫見秋香，秋香怒摑伯虎後離開，伯虎唱出三笑姻緣，秋香出現，皇上指枝山才是奸夫。石榴怒責枝山不負責任，就像與鳳姐一夕風流一事，猶如縮頭烏龜。

programme.desc: 閏為同戒煙。五、蘭被摩告發，泰禁蘭再返學堂。蘭以太后金牌逼泰成全，泰不理會。榮欠賭債被打，五等相救，同更借錢給榮。泰命明逐五出學堂，五闖泰府見蘭，明止。蘭偷走會五，二人決私奔。摩追至，五將摩打至重傷。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #12 [粵]
programme.desc: 五被收監，泰要處決五，蘭求摩醒來並答應下嫁，摩聞言甦醒。五得悉蘭要嫁摩，到王府找蘭卻被摩阻。蘭、五相遇，五冷言相對，蘭傷心。揚勸服怡給五開鏢局，並辭去武學堂教官協助五振作。五首次押鏢遇山賊，幸揚相救。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #88 [粵]
programme.desc: 眾人託清潔工阿嬋為他們購飯盒，但發現飯盒竟似度身訂製，眾人稱奇！不過眾人翻查資料，卻發現沒有這間茶餐廳。勇欲透過阿嬋找出那「不存在的茶餐廳」，卻因此發現阿嬋是利用公司的倉作廚房，包辦了區內的飯盒生意。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #89 [粵]
programme.desc: 昌發現哲拍拖沒有向恆公開二人的關係，勸哲坦白。恆的徒弟要為哲介紹女友，恆答應。恆無意中看到哲與瑤拍拖，明顯地反感，更要哲「相睇」，結果兩婆孫吵了起來。恆誤會哲離家出走，嵐略施小計使恆開始接受瑤。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #90 [粵]
programme.desc: 恆與山原想約嵐和哲行山，哲欲陪母親等送貨，恆感不是味兒。信指當年比堅更加早認識嵐，亦比堅對嵐更早產生愛意。而信更一直以筆名與嵐通信，而嵐則誤會寫信給她的人就是堅，更因巧合造就了嵐和堅的戀情。

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #49 [粵]
programme.desc: 伯虎為證明自己是「花癡」而大肆招親，秋香看見伯虎招親，伯虎赫見秋香，秋香怒摑伯虎後離開，伯虎唱出三笑姻緣，秋香出現，皇上指枝山才是奸夫。石榴怒責枝山不負責任，就像與鳳姐一夕風流一事，猶如縮頭烏龜。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #15 [粵]
programme.desc: 玉將自己的薪酬告之同事甘蓮與來發，兩人發覺玉人工幾乎倍於自己，因此大表不滿。斌自從回港後便一改活躍的性格，令玉摸不著頭腦。在眾好友努力下，瑩與龍幾經波折，二人終於復合。斌在學校打傷同學，不但沒有反省更打罵保，最後竟離家出走。幸得新提點，玉成功尋回兒子。但面對如此壓力，玉崩潰哭倒梯間。新成功開解玉，卻觸動自己當年與妻子女兒分離之事。龍等人執行任務期間，姜發現謙與如並肩而行，不禁主動上前查間兩人關係，令如哭笑不得。目標人物現身，眾人欲逮捕他之際卻引起槍戰，新更中槍倒地。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #32 [粵]
programme.desc: 培訓進入第二階段，學員們要到英國倫敦受訓半年。宏和嘉關係持續，但嘉認為曖昧關係不能繼續下去。娉借故在雄前往英國受訓前邀約他外出，麟在出發前也和芝約定好要互相寄生活照。嘉在休息室無意中撞破東和心打情罵俏。希開始駕駛訓練，琛更考驗她處理突發狀況的能力。晨往法國尋找休假已近半年的陽，陽為祝福晨與風而到了鎖橋，卻讓陽發現希之前留在橋上的手鐲。學員完成了英國的訓練，回港後便要開始預備筆試，但這時麟被兄長及教練邀請，希望他能復出代表香港參加比賽。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #33 [粵]
programme.desc: 新聞報道陽在外地飛行時失去了聯絡生死未卜，琛及希等人得知後都擔心不已。風發現晨情緒低落，特意留在她身旁陪伴。麟因預備考試和游泳訓練而弄垮了身體，並在考試前病倒，但仍強忍進行考試。宏的機長考試終於到了最後階段，但當他發現負責的Training Captain是曾在台灣共事的王機長後，卻緊張起來。琛召見麟，並告知他全部學員中只有他一個不合格，琛安排的補考時間，卻與港隊的游泳比賽相當接近。琛與希約會，並慶祝希順利通過筆試，但卻碰見了剛從外地回港的陽，陽更要希回到自己身邊。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #34 [粵]
programme.desc: 芝到維身處的酒店，發現兩人早已退了房間，芝收到琪傳來的短訊，看後大受打擊，麟見狀便陪芝回房讓她休息。芝獨自一人時，終在痛哭中崩潰。麟本前往集訓場地，但最後還是因為擔心芝而折返。嘉雖與宏有秘密關係，另一方面駿也對嘉展開追求。為慶祝嘉生日，駿特地大費周章，駿之後對嘉的追求行動開始愈來愈公開及主動，宏見狀卻心生妒意。琛和希決定往台灣高雄旅遊，卻碰巧被陽偷聽到。陽找晨詢問，並且知悉了緣分天使的故事，出發當日，陽故意與琛和希乘坐同一班機。

programme.title: 叛逃 #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 有正、有傑為追日嘉各出奇謀。記者葉婷進訓練營採訪，認識有正。日嘉對有正生興趣，親自找他。訓練生正男失戀，有正等陪他散心，有傑與流氓起衝突被帶返警署。眾被志敖處罰，正男被逐出ATF。有正兄弟找志敖理論。

programme.title: 叛逃 #5 [粵]
programme.desc: 志敖加強訓練難度，有正感被針對。有傑以為日嘉對自己有好感，怎料日嘉心繫有正。志敖接受正男回訓練營，有正兄弟對他改觀。有正及有傑等等取錄結果時接到命令。有正發現人質，情急下不顧志敖指示現身救人，陷險境。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 南思請迪迪把公文袋轉交芳凝，但迪迪卻因家明到台北接自己回港把事情忘了。芳凝提議與羅斌到西門紅樓，因是明霞捧她場的地方。尚恆把迪迪說出對男人的要求的偷拍片段放上網，並以「迷人Cheap Lady」為題。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 南思囑唐欣帶她的私生子Chris回家。芳凝離遠驚見失蹤多時的次女唐欣與Chris在一起，以為她當上未婚媽媽。尚恆故意讓迪迪知道自己是個窮光蛋，再把其反應偷拍放上網。羅斌為芳凝向南思解釋其對母親的誤會。

programme.desc: 新聞報道陽在外地飛行時失去了聯絡生死未卜，琛及希等人得知後都擔心不已。風發現晨情緒低落，特意留在她身旁陪伴。麟因預備考試和游泳訓練而弄垮了身體，並在考試前病倒，但仍強忍進行考試。宏的機長考試終於到了最後階段，但當他發現負責的Training Captain是曾在台灣共事的王機長後，卻緊張起來。琛召見麟，並告知他全部學員中只有他一個不合格，琛安排的補考時間，卻與港隊的游泳比賽相當接近。琛與希約會，並慶祝希順利通過筆試，但卻碰見了剛從外地回港的陽，陽更要希回到自己身邊。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #34 [粵]
programme.desc: 芝到維身處的酒店，發現兩人早已退了房間，芝收到琪傳來的短訊，看後大受打擊，麟見狀便陪芝回房讓她休息。芝獨自一人時，終在痛哭中崩潰。麟本前往集訓場地，但最後還是因為擔心芝而折返。嘉雖與宏有秘密關係，另一方面駿也對嘉展開追求。為慶祝嘉生日，駿特地大費周章，駿之後對嘉的追求行動開始愈來愈公開及主動，宏見狀卻心生妒意。琛和希決定往台灣高雄旅遊，卻碰巧被陽偷聽到。陽找晨詢問，並且知悉了緣分天使的故事，出發當日，陽故意與琛和希乘坐同一班機。

programme.title: 叛逃 #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 有正、有傑為追日嘉各出奇謀。記者葉婷進訓練營採訪，認識有正。日嘉對有正生興趣，親自找他。訓練生正男失戀，有正等陪他散心，有傑與流氓起衝突被帶返警署。眾被志敖處罰，正男被逐出ATF。有正兄弟找志敖理論。

programme.title: 叛逃 #5 [粵]
programme.desc: 志敖加強訓練難度，有正感被針對。有傑以為日嘉對自己有好感，怎料日嘉心繫有正。志敖接受正男回訓練營，有正兄弟對他改觀。有正及有傑等等取錄結果時接到命令。有正發現人質，情急下不顧志敖指示現身救人，陷險境。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 南思請迪迪把公文袋轉交芳凝，但迪迪卻因家明到台北接自己回港把事情忘了。芳凝提議與羅斌到西門紅樓，因是明霞捧她場的地方。尚恆把迪迪說出對男人的要求的偷拍片段放上網，並以「迷人Cheap Lady」為題。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 南思囑唐欣帶她的私生子Chris回家。芳凝離遠驚見失蹤多時的次女唐欣與Chris在一起，以為她當上未婚媽媽。尚恆故意讓迪迪知道自己是個窮光蛋，再把其反應偷拍放上網。羅斌為芳凝向南思解釋其對母親的誤會。

新聞掏寶
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新聞，明日歷史」。每天那麼多新聞，大家可能來不及消化，更遑論回望歷史。歷史就是一個大寶庫，少看歷史和小看歷史，很容易「走寶」。新節目《新聞掏寶》帶大家在寶庫「掏」新聞寶藏，除了昔日特輯、直播和系列報道，還有從未曝光的珍貴片段，觀眾有機會重溫李小龍出殯、寶生銀行劫案、四人幫審訊、英女王訪港、的士罷駛、中英簽訂聯合聲明、戴卓爾夫人專訪、越南難民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、啟德機場關閉、鄧小平逝世、九七回歸大典、華航香港空難和沙士記者會。

programme.desc: 鍾馗是中國民間傳說中驅鬼辟邪之神，從古至今，鍾馗打鬼捉妖的故事幾乎人人熟知，足見鍾馗在民間的影響極為深廣。據古籍記載，鍾馗被唐玄宗敕封為“驅魔大神”，遍行天下“斬妖驅邪”；又被玉皇大帝敕封為專管凡塵...

programme.title: 衛子夫 #30 [普]

programme.title: The Legend of the Condor Heroes #43 [Man]

programme.title: The Legend of the Condor Heroes #43 [Man]
